visualCharacteristics.purpose: Article author bios with photo, name, role and expandable bio
visualCharacteristics.description: Light grey #f3f3f3 panel, 30px padding: 30px/36px heading, then per author a 162px circular photo, 20px/500 name, 16px role and a 14px/19px bio clamped with an inline bold blue 'Read more' toggle.

contentPattern.description: Heading 'Author bio' + 2 authors (Nick Zylkowski, CFA; Christina Shockley)
contentPattern.structure: row 1: heading text (block field); then one row per author: cell 1 photo, cell 2 name (H3), role paragraph, bio paragraphs

reuseGuidance: The heading is a block-level field so it sits inside the grey panel. The Read more toggle appears only when a bio exceeds about 6 lines (plus one paragraph gap); short bios show in full.
